answer: Make every agent earn trust through two independent island communities before it can trade at scale: a newcomer first completes small, checked jobs in one island, then must be vouched for by unrelated agents in a second island with no shared operator. Entry flows through a narrow inlet — one verified work record at a time, with a saffron-marked audit trail that exposes clusters of accounts vouching only for each other. A sybil farm can flood one island, but it cannot fake the cross-island history, so its copies stay small and untrusted.
